Antidepressants - AZM 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-731218  
Guideline Name 
Antidepressants - AZM  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:generic citalopram oral solution, generic fluoxetine oral solution, generic 
sertraline oral conc for solution  
Diagnosis 
Requests for Patients greater than 12 years of age  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The member is unable to swallow the oral tablet/capsule  
 


=== PDF PAGE 123 ===
Page 123 
Product Name:Amitriptyline, amoxapine, bupropion tabs/SR tabs/XL tabs (150 and 300mg), 
citalopram tabs/oral soln, clomipramine, desipramine, generic desvenlafaxine ER, doxepin 
caps/oral conc for solution, duloxetine capsules (20, 30, 60mg), escitalopram tablets, 
fluoxetine caps/oral soln, fluvoxamine IR, generic mirtazapine tabs/ODT, imipramine 
tabs/caps, nortriptyline caps/oral soln, paroxetine tabs, protriptyline, sertraline tabs/oral soln, 
trazodone 50mg/100mg/150mg/300mg tabs, trimipramine, venlafaxine tabs/ER capsules  
Diagnosis 
PREFERRED DRUG Requests for patient 6 years of age or younger  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient is unresponsive to other treatment modalities, unless contraindicated (i.e. 
other medications or behavioral modification attempted)  
 
AND 
 
2 - The physician attests that the requested medication is medically necessary. (Document 
rationale for use)  
Notes  
Drug may require PA 
 
Product Name:Brand Venlafaxine besylate ER  
Diagnosis 
Non-Preferred Drugs  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient is unresponsive to other treatment modalities, unless contraindicated (i.e. 
other medications or behavioral modification attempted)  
 
AND 
 
2 - The physician attests that the requested medication is medically necessary. (Document 
rationale for use)  


=== PDF PAGE 124 ===
Page 124 
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has history of failure or intolerance to preferred generic venlafaxine or venlafaxine 
ER  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient has a history of failure, contraindication or intolerance to at least 2 preferred 
alternatives*  
• 
Bupropion (Generic Wellbutrin)

Product Name:Raldesy  
Diagnosis 
Non-Preferred Drugs

12 month(s)

Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Trial and failure, or intolerance to trazodone oral tablet

OR 
 
2 - Patient is unable to swallow the oral tablet formulation of trazodone  
 
Product Name:Auvelity tablets  
Diagnosis 
Non-Preferred Drugs: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of major depressive disorder (MDD)  
 
AND 
 
2 - The patient is unresponsive to other treatment modalities, unless contraindicated (i.e. 
other medications or behavioral modification attempted)  
 
AND 
 
3 - The physician attests that the requested medication is medically necessary. (Document 
rationale for use)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient has a history of failure, contraindication or intolerance to at least 3 preferred 
alternatives*  
• 
Bupropion (Generic Wellbutrin)  
• 
Bupropion SR (Generic Wellbutrin SR)  
• 
Bupropion XL (Generic Wellbutrin XL)  
• 
Citalopram (Generic Celexa)  
• 
Generic desvenlafaxine ER (Generic Pristiq)  
• 
Duloxetine 20mg, 30mg, or 60 mg capsules
